MISSION VIEJO CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING SUMMARY
  August 23, 2022
NOTE: This Summary is for informational purposes only and is not a record of the official action taken
by the Mission Viejo City Council. Approved City Council Meeting Minutes constitute the only record
of official City Council action. The minutes of this meeting will be available after they are approved by
the City Council at its next regularly scheduled meeting.

CALL TO ORDER — City Council, Community Development Financing Authority, Housing Authority,
Library Board of Trustees, and Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency.

Called to order at 5:00 p.m.

 INVOCATION: Council Member Kelley

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Mayor Pro Tem Sachs

 CLOSED SESSION

  CS1.  Conference with Legal Counsel: Existing Litigation Paragraph (1) of Subdivision (d) of
  Section 54956.9. Schlesinger v. City of Mission Viejo: 30-2022-01253878-CU-WM-CJC

  CS2.  Public Employee Performance Evaluation of the Incumbent for the Position of City
  Manager Pursuant to Government Code Sections 54957 and 54957.6

 REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

 PRESENTATIONS

  P1.  Friends of the Library Donation Presentation

  Mayor Bucknum received presentation from Library and Cultural Services Director Genesis
  Hansen.

  P2.  Presentation by the Transportation Corridor Agency

  Received presentations from Samuel Johnson, CEO of Transportation Corridor Agency.

 PUBLIC COMMENTS

 CONSENT CALENDAR

 S/K  Approved the Consent Calendar as outlined below.

City Council Summary  1  August 23, 2022
   1.  City Council Minutes

  Approved the Minutes for the regular City Council Meeting of July 12, 2022, as presented.

  2.  Check Register Dated July 8, 2022 in the Amount of $2,405,826.56

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  3.  Check Register Dated July 15, 2022 in the Amount of $1,410,179.91

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  4.  Check Register Dated July 22, 2022 in the Amount of $712,551.92

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  5.  Check Register Dated July 29, 2022 in the Amount of $3,280,662.51

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  6.  Check Register Dated August 5, 2022 in the Amount of $1,445,940.89

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  7.  City Treasurer’s Monthly Report for June 2022

  Received and filed.

  8.  Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency Treasurer’s Monthly Report
  for June 2022

  Received and filed.

  9.  Mission Viejo Community Development Financing Authority (MVCDFA) Treasurer’s
  Monthly Report for June 2022

  Received and filed.

  10.  Mission Viejo Housing Authority (MVHA) Treasurer’s Monthly Report for June 2022

  Received and filed.

  11.  Transmittal of Pre-PARE Trustee Reports for the Quarter Ending June 30, 2022

  Received and filed the accompanying Pre-PARE Trustee Reports for the quarter ending June
  30, 2022.

  12.  Tyler Munis ERP Financial, HR, and Payroll Software Renewal

City Council Summary  2  August 23, 2022
   Approved purchase order to Tyler Technologies, Inc. for 1-year renewal of software licensing
  and support for Munis ERP Financial, Human Resources, and Payroll system in the amount
  of $73,234.11.

  13.  Integrated Library System Software and Hardware Support Renewal

  Approved issuance of a purchase order in the amount of $79,958.11 for 1-year maintenance
  and support of the Integrated Library Systems (ILS) Software and Hardware Agreement with
  SirsiDynix, Inc.

  14.  2022 Residential Resurfacing (CIP 23838) - Slurry Seal

  Approved the bid specifications, subject to minor revisions required by the City Engineer,
  and authorized staff to advertise for constructions bids for the subject project.

  15.  Network Firewall Support Renewal

  Approved purchase order for network firewall annual support renewal to CompuCom
  Systems Inc. in the amount of $31,360.91.

  16.  Proposed Amendment to Existing Lease Submitted by Crown Castle in Conjunction
  with an existing Wireless Telecommunication Facility on the Tower at Pavion Park,
  24051 Pavion

  Approved and authorized the City Manager to Execute the Amended Lease.

  17.  Southern California Association of Governments (SCAG) Support Services

  Approved a contract with GSL Associates (A22-34) in the amount not to exceed $75,000 to
  provide Planning Support Services associated with the Southern California Association of
  Governments (SCAG) Transportation Committee (TC), Community, Economic and Human
  Development (CEHD) Committee, Energy and Environment Committee (EEC) and Regional
  Council.

  18.  Systemic Safety Analysis Report (SSAR) & Local Road Safety Plan (LRSP) and
  Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP) Call For Projects (Cycle 11)—Various
  Improvements

  Adopted Resolution 22-30 Certifying and Accepting the Systemic Safety Analysis Report
  (SSAR) & Local Road Safety Plan (LRSP) and Authorizing the Director of Public Works to
  Submit Applications for the Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP) Grant Funds for
  Various Safety Improvements Consistent with the SSAR and LRSP.

  19.  Mission Viejo Trash and Runoff Abatement Project (TRAP): North Central City Area
  (CIP 22250) - Notice of Completion

  (1) Certified the completion of and accept the improvements for the subject project; (2)
  authorized the City Manager to sign the Notice of Completion; (3) authorized the City Clerk
  to record the Notice of Completion with the County of Orange and to release the faithful
  performance and payment bonds one year and 35 days, respectively, after the date of

City Council Summary  3  August 23, 2022
   recordation of the Notice of Completion contingent upon no claims or liens being filed with
  the City; and (4) authorized the release of the final retention 35 days after the date of
  recordation of the Notice of Completion.

 ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR

 PUBLIC HEARINGS

  20.  Consideration of All Objections to the Proposed Abatement of Weeds on Parcels Less
  than One Acre for the Annual Weed Abatement Program 2022

  K/G  Instructed the Public Services Department to proceed and perform the removal of weeds in
  accordance with Sections 39568 through 39588 of the Government Code.

 OLD BUSINESS

  21.  Background on Conditional Use Permit CUP2021-430, for Oakhouse Church, 25282
  Marguerite Parkway

  S/K  Received report.

 NEW BUSINESS

  22.  Sober Living and Group Home Ordinance

  B/S  Approved Ordinance 22-345 establishing a Business Registry Requirement for Group Homes
  and Sober Living Homes located in the City of Mission Viejo, California and adding this New
  Chapter 5.06 to the Title 5-Business Regulations, of the City of Mission Viejo Municipal
  Code.

 MAYOR’S, COMMISSION, COMMITTEE REPORTS AND ACTIONS

  23.  Orange County Transportation Authority (OCTA) Report

  Nothing to report.

  24.  Orange County Fire Authority (OCFA) Report

  Received report.

  25.  Southern California Association of Governments (SCAG) Report

  Nothing to report.

  26.  Local Agency Formation Commission (LAFCO) Report

  Nothing to report.

 CITY MANAGER REPORT

City Council Summary  4  August 23, 2022
   27.  Update on the Status of the Housing Element

  Received update from Community Development Director Elaine Lister.

  Received update on Parks & Facilities Improvement Projects by Assistant City Manager
  Keith Rattay.

 CITY ATTORNEY REPORT

 COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS AND ACTIONS

  28.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended ~ AB1234

  Received reports.

 Council Member Goodell

 Council Member Kelley

 Council Member Raths

 Mayor Pro Tem Sachs

 Mayor Bucknum

ADJOURNMENT AT 9:22 P.M. TO TUESDAY, SEPTMEBER 13, 2022, AT 5:00 P.M.

City Council Summary  5  August 23, 2022
